g.text: DPR Dask Clusters (EOPF CPM and DPRprocessors)
Monitoring Stack (Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, Alloy)
All the web UIs and APIs authenticate the users withKeycloak (OAuth2 / OIDC) or with an API key (x-api-keyheader), and check their Keycloak roles.
Logs, metrics and OpenTelemetry traces of all thecomponents are collected by Alloy and Prometheus. Wazuhand NeuVector agents run on all the nodes. Grafana alsoreads the PostgreSQL databases.
Orange: external interfaces (all exposed byEnvoy Gateway in HTTPS). Grey: external systems.
search, staging, catalog & processing requests (rs-client, API key)
